entities.name: Sena Irie
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sena Irie  is a Japanese retired amateur boxer who won a gold medal in the inaugural women's featherweight event at the 2020 Summer Olympics. She became the first Japanese woman to win an Olympic gold medal in boxing.
